name: xAI Grok API token pricing (serverless, per 1M tokens, 2026-10-04 list price)
region: global API; US regional endpoint is a priced variant at 1.1x
price_basis: USD per 1M TOKENS, LIST PRICE, observed 2026-10-04. Every model with a 500k or 1M context window has TWO rate sets, short context and long context (>=200k tokens), and the rule stated on the page is that long-context rates apply to ALL tokens in a request once the prompt crosses the threshold. grok-4.7 (500k): short $2.00 input / $0.50 cached / $6.00 output; long $4.00 / $1.00 / $12.00. grok-4.6 (500k): same as 4.7. grok-4.5 (500k): short $2.00 / $0.30 / $6.00; long $4.00 / $0.60 / $12.00. grok-4.3 and grok-4.20 variants (1M): short $1.25 / $0.20 / $2.50; long $2.50 / $0.40 / $5.00. grok-build-0.1 (256k): short $1.00 / $0.20 / $2.00; long $2.00 / $0.40 / $4.00. price_usd = grok-4.7 short-context input. Requests to the US regional endpoint are billed at 1.1x the global token rates, a stated 10% premium.
notes: xAI's long-context rule is the harshest of the three providers that have one (OpenAI 2x, Anthropic n/a per-token, xAI 2x) because it is ALL-OR-NOTHING on the whole request, not a per-token split: one token past 200,000 doubles the entire bill including the tokens that were already short-context priced. Any xAI cost model that multiplies tokens by a blended rate will be wrong at the boundary. The US endpoint premium is a real 10% and it is easy to forget because the endpoint choice is a URL, not a plan. Non-text charges on the same page for completeness: image generation from $0.002-$0.01/img at $0.02-$0.25 out depending on resolution and model; video from $0.002/img + $0.01/sec input; speech-to-text $0.10/hr REST and $0.20/hr streaming; TTS $15.00 per 1M characters; speech-to-speech $0.08/min. No GPU hourly rate published.
